WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    s.telescref,
    o.weathprofile,
    AVG(s.modindex) as avg_modindex,
    AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshift
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY s.telescref, o.weathprofile
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as overall_avg_modindex
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.weathprofile,
    s1.avg_modindex,
    s1.avg_phaseshift,
    s1.avg_modindex - s2.overall_avg_modindex as diff
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s1.avg_modindex > s2.overall_avg_modindex
    AND s2.overall_avg_modindex IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  weathprofile,
  AVG(avg_modindex) as avg_step1_modindex,
  AVG(avg_phaseshift) as avg_step1_phaseshift,
  AVG(diff) as avg_diff
FROM step3
GROUP BY weathprofile
ORDER BY weathprofile
